title_en: The dogs bark, merchants are coming
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: 'с'јодам' is my reading as 'so I can go (away)'; 'калеш Димчо' read as a carriage-boy or driver (uncertain); 'прикрши' read as 'you will break/bend' (my reading).

words_to_learn.en: carriage, driver of a carriage (my reading)

lines.en: The dogs bark, merchants are coming

lines.cyr: пуштај ме, бела Митро да с'јодам.
lines.lat: puštaj me, bela Mitro da s'jodam.
lines.en: let me go, white Mitra, so I can leave.
Those dogs have barked since evening,
sit down beside me, carriage-boy Dimcho
you will break Mitra's slender waist.
The roosters crow, dawn is breaking
